_authoringNotes: WO-2004 - THE HEART LADDER, MOVED OUT OF CODE. Until 2026-09-06 the two numbers that define the realm-progression spine were C# literals: VillageTierService.MaxTier = 3 and NextCost() = 250 * next. They now live here and NOWHERE else; HeartProgressionCatalog is their only reader and VillageTierService projects them. Owner rules on balance - the values below are IDENTICAL to the constants they replaced (250 / 500 / 750, ceiling 3), so this file is a de-hardcoding, not a re-balance. WHAT THIS FILE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CARRY, and why (measured at source 2026-09-06, do not add these speculatively): (1) DURATION - VillageTierService.TryUpgrade is INSTANT (spend -> tier+1 -> Save -> Recompute); there is no Heart job kind, no queue channel and no timer. WO-2003 recorded that as an owner gap and it is still unruled. (2) PREREQUISITE CONDITIONS - CORRECTED 2026-09-07 (WO-2004 requirements lane). Until that date this note said none existed and told you not to add any; that was true of the tree and is no longer true of this file. Every level row now carries requiresBuildings, a list of {id, level} pairs meaning THAT BUILDING LADDER MUST ALREADY STAND AT THAT LEVEL before this Heart Level can be bought. Its only readers are HeartProgressionCatalog.RequirementsFor (parse) and HeartProgression.RequirementsFor (resolve against ModifierService.TierOf, in player words), and it is ENFORCED at the SOLE WRITER VillageTierService.TryUpgrade - so the Heart panel door AND the BuildingUpgradeVM door both honour it. ALL THREE ROWS ARE AUTHORED EMPTY ON PURPOSE: the owner rules on balance, so this lane shipped the SHAPE and the READER with ZERO behaviour change. Fill one array to add a gate; no code moves. Related, same lane: a level INSIDE maxLevel with NO row here used to cost 0 and be granted FREE while only tracing a Fail - TryUpgrade now REFUSES it, so a data hole can no longer hand the player the realm. (3) UNLOCK LISTS - buildings, troops, research, defenses and systems are NOT listed here on purpose. They are DERIVED: a building rung opens when building-tiers.json authors requiresVillageTier on it, its perks ride the same row, a troop opens when troops.json authors unlockBarracksTier on a barracks rung that the Heart just opened, and the population cap / echo workforce slots come from PopulationService and population-milestones.json. Listing them here as well would be the duplicated unlock table WO-2004's acceptance criteria forbid - the derivation IS the single authority. (4) REACH / INFLUENCE RADIUS - canon section 6 allows a Heart upgrade to expand buildable reach and owner ruling 12 requires the value be data-driven, but NO buildable-reach or influence-radius system exists in the tree (grepped across Assets/_Modules/Village/BuildMode 2026-09-06: zero hits). Authoring a radius here would be authoring a promise nothing can keep. It is a NEW FEATURE for the owner to rule on, not a missing number. (5) REWARD / MESSAGE METADATA - no reward grant path is wired to a Heart level. Every one of the five is a recorded gap in the WO-2004 reconciliation section, not an oversight. When one of them becomes real, add the field AND its production reader in the same change (AuthoredFieldReaderRegression fails a new authored string field that nobody reads).
